run_curl_training_mnist: run the CURL training experiment on the MNIST dataset using default parameters
run_curl_training_omniglot: run the CURL training experiment on the Omniglot dataset by passing --dataset=omniglot
review_main_entry_point: review the main function entry point that calls training.run_training with hardcoded hyperparameters
refactor_main_to_accept_flags: refactor the main function to accept more hyperparameters as absl flags instead of hardcoded values
summarize_training_hyperparameters: summarize the training hyperparameters including encoder decoder config and learning rate schedule
